Incorrect gamma for background color alpha when Windows ACM is enabled

Created attachment 9408505\\nScreenshot 2024-06-19 152141.png\\n\\nWhen Windows 11 Auto Color Management is enabled (\\"Automatically manage color for apps\\"), background colors with an alpha component (such as those specified with rgba) are displayed with an apparently incorrect gamma for the alpha component. It is especially noticeable in places like the GitHub diff view.\\n\\nThis occurs regardless of whether \\"Use legacy display ICC color management\\" is selected in the EXE compatibility options. It also occurs in the latest Firefox Nightly build. \\n\\nThis issue disappears in normal screenshots, however it does appear in OBS desktop capture (not window capture).

I need to implement a TextServicesCompositeDocument interface that will allow\\nthings like the message compose window to pass a collection of\\nnsITextServicesDocuments to a text service like the spellchecker. This will be\\nextremely useful when Ender replaces all textfields and textareas, and will\\nallow us to spellcheck not only the message body, but all text fields like the\\nsubject field, etc.
We can optimize the TransactionManager by implementing a TransactionItem\\nrecycler so that we don't have to allocate a new TransactionItem everytime we\\npush something on the Undo stack.
